svg.title: P4 easy: eighteen scorecard rows and two verified task checks
svg.desc: Luna · gpt-5.6-luna: 0 of 2 verified; Terra · gpt-5.6-terra: 0 of 2 verified; Sol · gpt-5.6-sol: 0 of 2 verified; Astra · gpt-6-astra: 2 of 2 verified; claude-opus-5-thinking-high: 2 of 2 verified; inherit: 2 of 2 verified; gpt-5.6-sol-medium: 1 of 2 verified; cursor-grok-4.6-high-fast: 1 of 2 verified; composer-2.5-fast: 0 of 2 verified; Jev Choice · five development runs: 0 of 2 verified; cat-jam-free: 0 of 2 verified; longcat-2.5-preview-free: 0 of 2 verified; space-bunny-free: 1 of 2 verified; mimo-v2.6-flash-free: 2 of 2 verified; step-5-preview-free: 1 of 2 verified; deepseek-v4.1-flash-free: 0 of 2 verified; muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free: 1 of 2 verified; nemotron-3.5-lightning-free: 1 of 2 verified. Jev's result occurred in each of five development runs with driver changes. The eight free-tier models of 15 October 2026 are listed in run order; they used an agent harness with an operator console, and MAST changed during that batch. The two checks are atom at target and neighbours preserved. An unverified check does not imply that a neighbour moved. All are P4 easy, seed 0, mode H development observations, not success rates or mode-A leaderboard results.
